assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Project-bound transparent raster sprite atlas for Chinese isometric 2D game 九鼎. Input 1 is the existing upper-body identity/style reference; input 2 shows the old lower-body movement atlas that needs replacement. Create a NEW MATCHING LOWER-BODY ONLY atlas to eliminate disconnected waist and mismatched proportions when layered beneath input 1. Preserve same child, cream hemp tunic hem, indigo baggy trousers, beige leg wraps, charcoal cloth shoes, black belt with small bronze buckle. Exactly four columns: facing RIGHT, facing DOWN toward camera, facing LEFT, facing UP away. Exactly eight rows: row 1 idle; rows 2-8 SEVEN successive running cycle poses. 32 separate sprites. Portrait canvas around 1024x1536, equal 256x192 cells; each sprite centered with generous transparent gutters. Each waist is 72 source pixels wide, belt top at same y in each cell; waist to sole about 145 source pixels, maximum stride width 150px. Match the upper reference line thickness and woodcut texture at this source scale; these pieces will all display at 0.20 scale, waist to foot 29 world pixels. The lower body begins with a flat BLACK BELT with bronze buckle and a SHORT continuous cream tunic hem, then joined hips and legs; no floating parts, no cropped feet, no second belt, no head or torso or arms or scarf or weapon. Maintain pelvis center and waist anchor across all run poses, natural changing feet and knees, restrained cloth motion. Folk shadow-puppet silhouette, engraved woodcut detail and subtle pixel texture. Real fully transparent background, no backdrop, no cast shadow, no haze, no glow, no text, no gridlines, no separators, no labels. Old atlas is movement reference only: specifically improve anatomical continuity, scale consistency and clean alpha. Deliver the full lower-body atlas only.

Use case: style-transfer. Project raster sprite atlas for 九鼎. Input image is the existing bronze bird-mask enemy atlas, used solely for camera, sprite scale, action layout and folk woodcut rendering. Make ONE NEW ENEMY APPEARANCE: a slender ash-paper puppet with a cracked ivory round ritual mask, two tiny muted vermilion eye-slits, indigo-black torn hemp wraps, layered cream paper talisman skirt, short broken wooden cleaver. Chinese folklore shadow puppet silhouette, engraved wood grain, subtle pixel texture, warm ochre highlights; no cartoon gloss. Exactly 28 complete separate full-body sprites, 7 columns by 4 rows, same direction and animation scheme as reference. Rows: facing RIGHT, facing DOWN toward camera, facing LEFT, facing UP away. Columns: idle; left-foot walking; right-foot walking; raised cleaver warning pose; forward melee cleave; recoiling hurt/recovery; collapsed paper fragments death. Every foot anchor same baseline per row, body same height/scale all poses, weapon never extends beyond its cell. Wide canvas around 1792x1024, generous empty gutters, NO overlapping sprites, no touching adjacent cells. Each body 150 pixels tall, centered in cell. Transparent background ONLY, absolutely no ground, no cast shadows, no haze or glow or backplate, zero opacity outside sprite. No words, labels, grid, UI or border. This is an appearance variant using existing melee hit range, not a boss or ranged caster.
